تزدهفين (form VIII)
# تَزْدَهِفِينَ (tazdahifīna) /taz.da.hi.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# تُزْدَهَفِينَ (tuzdahafīna) /tuz.da.ha.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
